item.title: California schools with low vaccination rates lose millions of dollars
item.description: California schools lost more than $2.2 million in state funding over two years due to student vaccination noncompliance, state data show. item.title: School districts can set aside prayer time under a new Texas law. Few have done so
item.description: Most Texas school districts have declined a new state-approved opportunity to set aside time each day for students and staff to pray before school. So far, only 15 districts have opted into the voluntary prayer period, while many urban, suburban and rural districts have voted against it.
